verdict.rationale: A GPU ships with first-party driver and NVIDIA app software, so whether users can opt out of telemetry is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The 'fully private' marketing line is about running AI models locally, which is an adjacent claim and not a telemetry control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
